title: ONNX-EdgeIDS: A Lightweight Two-Stage Edge Serving Toolkit for Network Intrusion Detection
description:
ONNX-EdgeIDS is research software for deploying machine-learning network intrusion detection on resource-constrained edge devices. It provides Kafka and ZeroMQ replay for CICIDS2017-derived flow records, a first-stage anomaly gate that filters high-volume traffic, and a second-stage tree-ensemble classifier served by ONNX Runtime or by a dependency-minimal NumPy engine exported from the same ONNX graph, together with a release gate that checks the two runtimes agree before deployment.

This release adds research results; the serving toolkit (ONNX Runtime backend, NumPy engine, exporter, release gate and artifacts) is unchanged since 0.7.0. The research/ directory gains the confidence-checking replay and data-free gates over four further training seeds, Hummingbird as a third-party runtime on the CPU, the Apple GPU and a Jetson Orin CUDA GPU at float32, TF32 and bf16 matmul precision, an ablation over coupled faults confined to one element, and the gate run under ONNX Runtime 1.26.0, 1.27.0 and 1.30.0, whose first two releases relabel single-column binary random forests and are failed by both replay and the data-free probes.
